_comment: Copy to ~/.pr-watcher/config.json (or set PRW_* env vars). Every field is optional — repo and self_login auto-detect from the gh CLI if omitted.
_merge_comment: Leave merge_skill unset for a plain 'gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch'. Set it to a Claude skill/slash-command name to run your own merge workflow instead, in target_repo_dir.
